Seriously, taking a shower doesn't help much when you have to put on the same clothes. We had an 18 hour layover in Singapore- I didn't realize I wouldn't be getting my checked luggage back since final destination was India. Singapore was really nice. Reminded me of HI. The whole island was pretty much a huge shopping mall. We just rolled into Bangalore tonight at 9, technically I have no idea what time my body thinks it is. Thank god I have pills to sleep or I'd be a mess.
The apts are pretty big- I got one of the bigger ones since I'm older- haha. Nice
So far Bangalore at night seems a lot like Mexico. We'll see what tomorrow has to bring. So far no sickness- but i did wash out my mouth with the water when I was brushing my teeth- I totally forgot.
BTW, it was cold here tonight- we'll see how bearable tomorrow is!
